backlink_pages.title: Data Retention Policy
backlink_pages.author: Jordan Lee
backlink_pages.excerpt: Policy summary Workspace data is retained for the life of the subscription plus thirty days. Worker job history is partitioned for cold storage; do not invent ad-hoc retention flags in product code.

comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Customer on tenant nimbus-demo-west re-uploaded a 12 MB HAR this morning — still stuck pending after 90 minutes. Reopening because the partial fix never rolled to production EU.

content.text: Customer on tenant nimbus-demo-west re-uploaded a 12 MB HAR this morning — still stuck pending after 90 minutes. Reopening because the partial fix never rolled to production EU.

Attachments larger than 8 MB that land on a customer ticket never leave the virus_scan_pending state. Smaller files (we tested 3.2 MB and 7.9 MB PDFs) finish scanning in under 40 seconds and become downloadable; a 8.1 MB zip stays pending indefinitely.

Expected: the scan worker marks the object clean or quarantined and flips attachment.scan_status within a few minutes. Actual: the row stays pending, the agent UI shows a spinner forever, and the customer sees "scan in progress" with no retry path.

Likely cause is the scan client reusing a single signed GET URL whose expiry is hardcoded to 60 seconds while the AV worker streams the full object through ClamAV. For files past ~8 MB the download exceeds that window, the stream aborts mid-read, and the worker retries with the same expired cursor instead of minting a fresh URL.
NMS-facing: three enterprise accounts filed this in the last fortnight. Agents cannot share large diagnostic dumps until scan completes, so escalations stall.
